notes:
- **The real fix for the random crashes.** We found the true cause: the app
  made several web requests at once over a single connection that wasn't safe
  to share between them, which could corrupt memory and close the app at
  random — ticking a suggestion, opening a page, loading thumbnails, anything.
  Those requests are now handled one-at-a-time behind the scenes, so the
  overlap that caused the crashes can't happen. (Last week's engine change
  helped, but this was the underlying cause.)
